raw.query: SELECT d.tp, d.n_replicas, d.window_name, p.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = p.run_id AND d.is_current WHERE p.is_current AND p.window_name BETWEEN 'burst1' AND 'burst5' AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND d.experiment = 'grid' AND d.pool = 'language' AND d.policy IS NULL AND ((d.tp IS NULL AND d.n_replicas = 4) OR (d.tp = 2 AND d.n_replicas = 2)) ORDER BY d.n_replicas, d.window_name, p.p99_ms
raw.observed: grid experiment: N4 tp=null P99 range 1313.8–1331.4ms (fails all 5 windows, SLA=1000ms); TP2_N2 P99 range 746.3–845.7ms (passes all 5). Ratio range 1.55–1.76× across window/measurement combos
raw.claimed: TP1×4 fails all five burst windows, TP2×2 passes each, 1.55–1.74× tail cut
raw.evidence: Both configs are static knee runs in the same grid experiment; TP1×4 P99 >1000ms on all five burst1-5, TP2×2 P99 <1000ms on all five. Ratios span 1.55–1.76 (claimed 1.55–1.74); upper bound stray of 0.02 is minor. Note: DB encodes this as tp=NULL not tp=1 for N4 — semantically equivalent (no tensor parallelism) but column disagrees with label
raw.fix: Consider noting that tp=NULL (not tp=1) encodes the 4-replica no-TP config in provenance, or narrow ratio range to 1.55–1.76 to match all measurement variants
